note_tweet.text:
I've realized that I often rely too much on one person or one relationship. As long as that person leaves me, I collapse and feel lost. And this kind of dependence of mine easily puts pressure on the other person, which makes our relationship become unhealthy, and then I easily end up being distanced, disliked, and tired of. I want to get rid of this excessive dependence, but I really can't do it. I know the only person I can excessively rely on is myself, but I can't live by simply relying on such a terrible self.
Please don't hate me.
